atoms.b: Hello, I’m ((++Carl_Linnaeus Marie_Curie)), a Swedish scientist from the ((++1700s 900s)).
There are millions of different ((++organisms organs)) — or living things — in the world, and we need to be able to sort them into different groups based on their ((++features names)).
Therefore, I came up with the system of ((++classification disorganisation))! We classify organisms so that we can ((++identify multiply)) and study them more effectively.

instruction.text: Read the text and decide if the statements are true or false.

atoms.text: A classification key is a set of questions about the features of organisms. Classification keys are used to identify unknown living things and decide which group they are part of. This image shows a classification key used to group vertebrates.

atoms.a: A classification key is a set of questions.
Classification keys are based on the names of organisms.
Classification keys are used to identify unknown organisms.
Organisms can be classified into three main groups: plants, animals and microorganisms.
